name: Motsureta Nekutai wa Saijokai de Koi o Suru
original_name: もつれたネクタイは最上階で恋をする
source:
The main character join the the longed-for advertising agency where he meets "Him".While he works under his supervision, adoration gradually develops into a special feeling...
Painful yet unstoppable feeling among men.
There is no going back once you fall for.
Enjoy "The Exquisit Top Floor Office Love" with men in beautiful suit.
[https://apps.apple.com/us/app/lover-in-necktie-boys-love/id670858074]
translation:
男主角如愿进入了心仪已久的广告公司，并在那里遇见了“他”。在对方手下共事的日子里，最初的憧憬渐渐发酵成了一份特殊的情愫……
男人之间苦涩却又难以抑制的爱意。
一旦沦陷，便再也无法回头。
与西装革履的精英男士们共谱一曲“顶层办公室的精致恋歌”吧。
[来源：https://apps.apple.com/us/app/lover-in-necktie-boys-love/id670858074]
